metadata.description: Floppy (Atlas) plugins for Cowork — knowledge-grounded operator workflows.

plugins.name: floppy
plugins.description: Generic Floppy plugin: grounded read/write over your business memory via the remote Floppy MCP, plus automatic source-evidence capture of agent sessions. No client-specific meeting workflows.

plugins.name: floppy-dd-meeting-notes
plugins.description: Floppy meeting notes, memory search, and review-required draft workflows. Includes session capture hooks and 6 skills (meeting-notes, brief, digest, follow-up, agenda, proposal).

plugins.name: floppy-noah-meeting-notes
plugins.description: Drop a meeting transcript, get a grounded recap + Todoist task list for the serious-people tenant. Grounded only in Floppy memory. Bundles the Floppy remote MCP.
